subject: Re: Operational proof for non-training & sandboxed processing
messages:
From: Elena Rossi <elena.rossi@novamed.com>
To: kimberly_park <kimberly_park@redwoodinference.com>, marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: James O'Neill <james.oneill@novamed.com>, legal@novamed.com
Date: Thu, 1 Oct 2026 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: Operational proof for non-training & sandboxed processing

Hi Kimberly / Marissa,

Thanks again for the call earlier. As we scope the pilot (HIPAA data), our legal and privacy teams have two outstanding asks before we can sign the DPA redline:

1) Operational proof that NovaMed’s inputs will not be used for model improvement (no-training). We need a concise attestation + the ops playbook that would be executed if we request evidence.
2) A working design for a sandboxed processing option (either on-prem connector or dedicated VPC processing) and how logs/telemetry are segregated and exported.

Can you provide a short runbook and any supporting artifacts this week? If you have a draft attestation we can share with Legal, that would speed review.

Appreciate it — Elena

--
Elena Rossi
Head of Privacy & Compliance, NovaMed
elena.rossi@novamed.com

Attachment: sample-data-class-map.csv (referenced)

From: kimberly_park <kimberly_park@redwoodinference.com>
To: Elena Rossi <elena.rossi@novamed.com>
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>, aditya_rao <aditya_rao@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 1 Oct 2026 10:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Operational proof for non-training & sandboxed processing

Elena — thanks for the clear asks. Short answer: yes, we can provide both an operational attestation and a sandboxed processing design.

Next steps I propose (timeline inside):
- We’ll attach a one-page attestation letter that covers our standard no-training commitment for the NovaMed pilot (draft attached). (TODAY)
- Ops will provide a 2–3 page runbook describing evidence collection, audit logs, and how we produce a tamper-evident export. (48–72 hours)
- Solutions will provide two processing options: SaaS dedicated VPC routing + an on-prem SFTP ingest/ephemeral processing flow, with a simple decision matrix. (EOD Friday)

I’ve looped in Aditya from Legal to sign off on wording that aligns with your DPA redlines. I’m also attaching a processing-sandbox-design.pdf (draft) and our proposed redline-dpa-no-train.docx so Legal can mark it up.

Would you prefer the attestation as a stand-alone PDF we sign, or integrated language in the DPA?

Thanks — Kim

--
Kimberly Park
Head of Customer Privacy, Redwood Inference
kimberly_park@redwoodinference.com
Attachment: processing-sandbox-design.pdf; redline-dpa-no-train.docx

From: aditya_rao <aditya_rao@redwoodinference.com>
To: kimberly_park <kimberly_park@redwoodinference.com>, Elena Rossi <elena.rossi@novamed.com>
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 1 Oct 2026 12:19:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Operational proof for non-training & sandboxed processing

Elena / Kim — Draft notes from Legal: we reviewed Kimberly’s proposed attestation and attached a redline with two modest asks:

- Narrow the scope language to the NovaMed pilot and explicitly call out "no use for model improvement or ranking" and the retention window for telemetry (30 days by default, unless otherwise agreed).
- Include an evidence checklist and contact points for an operational audit request (we added a stubbed checklist in the redline).

I attached the redline-dpa-no-train.docx with inline comments. We prefer providing the attestation as a signed standalone PDF (simpler for procurement) and keeping the DPA language focused on contractual commitments. If NovaMed wants both, we can provide both.

Small request: can NovaMed confirm whether they require onshore data residency for audit artifacts? That will affect our recommended export path.

Thanks — Aditya

--
Aditya Rao
General Counsel, Redwood Inference
aditya_rao@redwoodinference.com
Attachment: redline-dpa-no-train.docx

From: James O'Neill <james.oneill@novamed.com>
To: kimberly_park <kimberly_park@redwoodinference.com>, aditya_rao <aditya_rao@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Elena Rossi <elena.rossi@novamed.com>, legal@novamed.com
Date: Thu, 1 Oct 2026 14:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Operational proof for non-training & sandboxed processing

Kim / Aditya — quick answers from NovaMed Legal:
- We appreciate the standalone attestation option; please provide that as a PDF we can attach to the SOW.
- Onshore residency for audit artifacts: for the pilot we require EU residency for artifacts (customer-controlled SFTP or a EU KMS).
- For the sandboxed processing options, please include the expected effort and a one-time setup estimate (engineering hours) so Procurement can budget.

Also linking our procurement tracker (DocuSign will follow once DPA language is agreed): https://www.docusign.com/records/NOVAMED-8247

Best, James

--
James O'Neill
Director, Strategic Procurement, NovaMed

From: kimberly_park <kimberly_park@redwoodinference.com>
To: James O'Neill <james.oneill@novamed.com>, Elena Rossi <elena.rossi@novamed.com>
Cc: aditya_rao <aditya_rao@redwoodinference.com>, marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 1 Oct 2026 16:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Operational proof for non-training & sandboxed processing

James / Elena — great, thanks for the clarifications. Summary of agreed execution plan and owners:

1) Attestation PDF: Legal (Aditya) will finalize the standalone attestation with the narrowed scope and telemetry retention clause. We’ll deliver the signed PDF within 24 hours. (Owner: Aditya)
2) Evidence runbook & export path: Ops will deliver the 2–3 page runbook describing audit artifact generation, tamper-evident exports, and EU SFTP export for NovaMed. (Owner: Marissa)
3) Sandboxed processing options + cost estimate: Solutions will deliver a short matrix with effort estimates for (a) dedicated VPC routing with EU KMS, and (b) on-prem SFTP ephemeral processing including one-time integration hours. (Owner: Kim / Marissa)

Attachments sent to you in this thread: processing-sandbox-design.pdf (draft), redline-dpa-no-train.docx. We will post the final artifacts to the Drive link and send the signed attestation PDF when ready.

If this plan looks right I’ll mark the task complete on our side and circulate the Drive folder.

Thanks again — Kim

--
Kimberly Park
Head of Customer Privacy, Redwood Inference
kimberly_park@redwoodinference.com
Attachments referenced: processing-sandbox-design.pdf; redline-dpa-no-train.docx; attestation-no-train-draft.pdf (to follow)
